data.title: Chat: chat.js probe budget accepts values above 2^31-1, which Node clamps to 1 ms — a budget of 2147483648 refuses a live server after 54 ms naming a budget it never spent (AS-83 Ruben F-1)

data.body: Context (cto-owen, filed at the AS-83 merge, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 21): Ruben's AS-83 review F-1. The CHAT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS / probe-budget validation in apps/chat/bin/chat.js + lib/client.js accepts any positive integer, but Node clamps setTimeout delays above 2^31-1 to 1 ms, so a budget of 2147483648 makes the probe refuse a live server after ~54 ms while the refusal names a budget it never spent. The AS-24 boundary itself held (exit 1, no DB touched) so this is low severity; Ruben recommended a follow-up rather than a rework cycle. Fix shape: one validation guard (reject > 2147483647 with a message naming the ceiling) plus one T3-style case that reds without it. Priority low; not in the Chat-set ordering rule's named list, so it queues by age. Reviewer should not be Ruben (he named the fix).

Pulled into the lifecycle (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 15). Two-stage path, complexity low (one guard + one test, per the filing comment): Lena plans + implements in one stage in .worktrees/AS-113; Priya reviews (not Ruben — he named the fix). Priority stays medium: a behaviour defect in shipped code (the refusal names a budget it never spent). Fable refused every spawn at 429 last tick; Opus fallback per CLAUDE.md if it recurs.

Implementation stage complete (developer-lena, two-stage path, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 15; ran on Opus under the Fable fallback). Complexity low confirmed — not re-marked.

Decision: one guard at the one parse boundary. MAX_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2147483647 is exported from lib/client.js beside DEFAULT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS (the ceiling is a fact about AbortSignal.timeout being a Node timer, reproduced on Node v24.13.1: 2147483648 emits TimeoutOverflowWarning and sets the delay to 1 ms; 2147483647 is accepted with no warning). bin/chat.js probeBudget() rejects ms > MAX after the AS-83 positive-integer check, on every path (rule 4 included), with: chat: invalid CHAT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS '<raw>' — above 2147483647 ms, the Node timer ceiling; a larger delay is clamped to 1 ms (AS-113). probe() itself gets no second guard — the CLI is its only caller in the codebase. Usage text and the README env-table row name the ceiling. One new case T5 in test/mode.test.js (rule-4 spawns, CHAT_DB only): '2147483648' → exit 1, /invalid CHAT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS/, /'2147483648'/, /2147483647/, no DB touched; control '2147483647' → exit 0 (bound is >, not >=).

Commits: plan 742b404 (master), branch/worktree 6d5b850 (master), code de5fd0b on feat/AS-113-probe-budget-ceiling (4 files: bin/chat.js, lib/client.js, test/mode.test.js, README.md; +47/-3). Worktree .worktrees/AS-113 clean at de5fd0b.

Cardinality then quantification. Host baseline before any edit (worktree): 623 tests / 621 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped. Predicted +1.
- run-1 compose (node apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs, -p asc-impl-as113, --build): 'Image asc-impl-as113-test Built', 624/616/0/8, exit 0, leak check clean — exactly baseline 623/615/0/8 + T5.
- M1 (AC-1: ceiling block deleted from probeBudget; applied-assertion in the probeBudget→resolveBackend slice: MAX_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS 2→0) through compose: 'Image asc-impl-as113-test Built', 624/615/1/8. Red set exactly {T5}, failing at 'channels (CHAT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS=2147483648): exit 0 signal null after 547 ms' — the in-image proof the guard was absent. T3 (AS-83 positive-integer case) green. Restored via git checkout, 'git diff --exit-code' clean.
- M2 (AC-2: message loses the number, 'above the ceiling'; 1→0) host node --test test/mode.test.js: 14 cases, 13/1, red exactly {T5} at 'the refusal names the ceiling'.
- M3 (AC-3: > becomes >=; 0→1) host mode.test.js: 14 cases, 13/1, red exactly {T5} at the control 'channels (CHAT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS=2147483647): exit 1'. Restored, clean.
- run-3 compose final rebuild after the mutants: 'Image asc-impl-as113-test Built', 624/616/0/8, exit 0, leak clean. Host full suite after restore: 624/622/0/2, exit 0. Every red set matched its prediction — none wider, none narrower.

Plan erratum (recorded, not blocking): §4 AC-1 predicted the applied-assertion count as 1→0; observed 2→0 because the doc comment I added above probeBudget also names MAX_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS. The site is still unambiguous (the slice holds nothing else).

Left open for the reviewer: (a) probe() takes a raw number with no guard of its own — deliberate, one boundary; if a second library caller ever appears the ceiling should move into probe(). (b) T5 proves the guard on the no-probe path (rule 4); the live-server shape Ruben observed (slow proxy + 2^31 budget → refusal after ~54 ms) is not re-enacted as a test because the guard now fires before any probe runs. Logs: scratchpad/developer-lena/AS-113/{host-baseline,run-1,run-2-M1,run-3,host-final}.log. Not transitioned to review — Owen does that.

Stage closed by the orchestrator (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 15). Two-stage path (Lena on Opus under the Fable fallback): plan 742b404, tip de5fd0b (4 files +47/-3): MAX_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2147483647 exported from lib/client.js, probeBudget() in bin/chat.js rejects above it on every path with a message naming the ceiling (AS-113); probe() itself unguarded since the CLI is its only caller; usage text and README env row updated; new T5 in test/mode.test.js (2147483648 -> exit 1 naming the ceiling, no DB touched; control 2147483647 -> exit 0). Receipts: compose asc-impl-as113 'Image asc-impl-as113-test Built' 624/616/0/8 (= last merged 623/615/0/8 + 1); host 624/622/0/2. Red sets exact: M1 guard deleted -> {T5} in-image; M2 message loses the number -> {T5}; M3 > to >= -> {T5} via the control. Plan erratum: AC-1 applied-assertion predicted 1->0, observed 2->0 (doc comment names the constant). Reviewer: Priya (not Ruben — he named the fix), cold, in .worktrees/AS-113. Assigned qa-priya.
